notes.title: Halloween 2023 Update
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween! Looks like Halloween Forest has some new spooky changes! Lets see what is different shall we?

- Added Steam Achievements

- Added Jukebox/Screensaver mode! (Wait 90 seconds on main menu or press "J" to launch Jukebox) You can cycle through over 50 spooky Halloween tracks just use the arrow keys on your keyboard!

- New water material in swamp

- Player now stays on moving platforms without additional player input

notes.title: UI Primitive Menu Patch
notes.notes:
New Primitive Menu (WIP)
1) Pause menu added
2) Quality option added
3) Sensitivity option added
4) Volume option added
5) Fullscreen/Window option added 


Additional Support
1) Added support for Nintendo  Switch Controllers (Beta)


Minor Changes/Optimizations/Bug Fixes
1) Overall game performance has been improved
2) Ghost race soft lock has been fixed
3) Game can now be exited normally
4) Beating the game now can take you back to the starting menu
5) Collisions added for Portal Statues
6) Added new graphic when collecting pumpkins for Jack

notes.title: Launch Update
notes.notes:
Quality of life changes

1-Poku Swamp made more fair with alternate route added and speed adjustments on platforms

2- Grub's hot potatoe tag timer reduced to 75 seconds from 90 seconds

3- Player can now skip intro after 5 seconds

4- Ghost race made more fair with cave rock adjustments

5- Ghost race has been made slightly easier (Ghost moves slightly slower) 

6- Ghost race now only starts when player is looking towards the correct direction

7- Controller look speed slightly increased from 5.625 to 5.85
